split_justification.separation: normative and determinative stay in separate commits; position 1 is normative, position 2 is determinative
split_justification.reason: One normative commit suffices: the scanner, the register, the repairs and the block contract form one testable whole, and no part changes runtime behaviour another part must already rest on. The determinative position exists so evidence describes a fixed commit instead of a moving worktree.
condition_per_commit: the position is self contained: it introduces no reference to an artifact a later position creates
the full tooling test suite passes
the configuration loader binding check passes
every phase declared for the changed subject has run against the new scope (R5)
a commit that introduces or changes a block manifest is green only when every phase that manifest declares has run against it
split_justification.context_rule: If the context runs short, work stops before the commit and reports, rather than leaving finished work unsecured or committing it unverified.

guard_package_affected.reason: B0e changes no file under tools/guard, tools/guardpkg or tools/guardops; the manifest's product guard forbids those paths, so the installed guard, its package and its digest stay untouched and no owner activation exists in this block.
